Two returned Instagram entries have mp4 targets expressed through short-link proxy paths; eight are platform iframe targets. No proxy/media request made, so playableKind does not demonstrate network availability or decoding.

Final LIVE/RECENT eligibility requires freshness AND a dated outlet match; older/undated/unmatched clips remain ARCHIVAL. Archival banner uses incident date. Current API observation aligns with this rule.

Rail consumes basic source/clip/done status but ignores verification and ranked events and does not surface done.pluginCalls or source.errors/captions/primary. A done chip with nonzero clips therefore hides upstream degraded dependencies.

EOF without explicit done synthesizes done with counts {}, so a prematurely ended SSE can appear completed with zero per-platform counts although clips arrived. This was NOT reproduced in the live call (real done received).
Existing QA requires >=2 platforms plus real advancing muted video and correct badges, not a fixed total. It was inspected only, not executed, because browser use is prohibited.
